entry.title: Bahcesehir College Istanbul - Kids&Us Manresa | Round 3 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27

media:group.media:title: Bahcesehir College Istanbul - Kids&Us Manresa | Round 3 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Bahcesehir remained undefeated in Group D by downing Manresa 100-88 at Sinan Erdem Sports Hall. Bahcesehir improved to 3-0 in the standings while Manresa dropped to 1-2. Marcquise Reed led the winners with 22 points. Malachi Flynn added 16 while Tyler Cavanaugh and Mateusz Ponitka each had 12 for Bahcesehir, which led from start to finish. Timmy Allen paced Manresa with 21 points. The visitors managed to get as close as 62-59 late in the third quarter before Bahcesehir boosted its margin to 95-77 with 4 minutes remaining, enough to hold off Manresa's late run.

media:group.media:title: Neptunas Klaipeda - Cosea JL Bourg-en-Bresse | Round 3 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Neptunas grabbed its first victory of the season after wasting an 18-point lead but still beating Bourg 93-89 at home in Group C to keep the reigning champions winless. Elvar Fridriksson drained the game-deciding three-pointer with 13 seconds left and finished with 25 points - just like teammate Yannick Franke, while Henri Drell scored 18 points for 1-2 Neptunas. Bourg fell to 0-3 in Group C despite Assemian Moulare tallying 17 points, 4 rebounds and 5 assists and Keith Jordan chipping in 16 points.

entry.title: Lietkabelis Panevezys - PAOK Thessaloniki | Round 3 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27

media:group.media:title: Lietkabelis Panevezys - PAOK Thessaloniki | Round 3 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Lietkabelis came out victorious from its first-ever battle against PAOK by beating the Greek side 95-86. A sublime Alexander Schumacher led the charge with 23 points, while Ognjen Jaramaz went 6-for-9 from the field, finishing the game on 18 points. The hosts led for the majority of the duel, absorbing PAOK’s comeback attempts in the second half to secure a rather comfortable victory – their second at home this season. Marcus Foster went 8-for-11 from inside the arc, pacing PAOK with 21 points, but couldn't help the visitors avoid their first defeat. Both teams now hold 2-1 records.

media:group.media:description:
Kids&Us Manresa got off the mark for the season on Wednesday night, fighting past ratiopharm ulm 101-89 at home.
The host was one point short of tying a club record for most points in the first half, with a 62-45 lead at the break, but let a 23-point lead dwindle to just eight in fourth quarter.
Manresa held on for a 1-1 mark in Group D as Timmy Allen led the way with 30 points, and JD Notae had 20.

entry.title: Roma Basketball - Lietkabelis Panevezys | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27

media:group.media:title: Roma Basketball - Lietkabelis Panevezys | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Roma recorded its first win in Group D by edging Lietkabelis 92-87 in Round 2 at Palazzetto Dello Sport. Both teams now have 1-1 records. Niccolo Mannion and Marko Simonovic paced the winners with 21 points apiece and Erik Stevenson and Paul Watson added 11 apiece. Ivan Fevrier and Keondre Kennedy led Lietkabelis with 15 points apiece.
Lietkabelis trailed most of the way after the break, but rallied to within 88-87 in the final minute on a layup by Ognjen Jaramaz. Simonovic banked in a close shot, grabbed a key defensive rebound at the other end and sealed the outcome from the foul line with 13.8 seconds remaining.

entry.title: Aris Thessaloniki - Recoletas Salud San Pablo Burgos | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27

media:group.media:title: Aris Thessaloniki - Recoletas Salud San Pablo Burgos | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Aris romped to a second successive win in Group A as it strolled past Burgos after the hosts thrived in a cracking atmosphere generated by fervent home fans. Aris wiped out an early 4-8 deficit and led 53-30 at halftime on the back of strong play from Jeremiah Robinson-Earl and Adam Mokoka.
Burgos fought hard to get back into the game and slashed the deficit to 61-48 late in the third but Aris held firm as Robinson-Earl registered a double-double of 11 points and 10 boards while Neno Dimitrijevic finished on 21 points and 6 assists. Chase Audige stood out for Burgos on a game-high 25 points and Sekou Doumbouya added 18.

entry.title: Baglietto Derthona Tortona - Le Mans Sarthe Basket | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27

media:group.media:title: Baglietto Derthona Tortona - Le Mans Sarthe Basket | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Derthona celebrated its first-ever EuroCup win when it defeated visiting Le Mans 89-83 at Nova Arena. Despite a strong start in both the first and third periods, Derthona saw Le Mans enter crunch-time with an 80-83 advantage, but the home team reacted in style with 9-0 run in the last 1:35 to close a game that saw 14 lead changes and 5 ties.
Justin Gorham led the way for Derthona with 22 points and 8 boards, with Prentiss Hub, Karim Jallow and Dante Maddox also scoring in double-figures. Moses Wood and Jordan King supported Le Mans with 18 and 17 points, respectively, off the bench.

media:group.media:title: NINERS Chemnitz - Neptunas Klaipeda | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
The NINERS led for the majority of the contest, before eventually claiming a 93-84 victory over Neptunas. Rodrigo Pastore’s men raced out to an early lead and stayed in control until the final quarter, when they were hit by a late comeback attempt from the visitors, who managed to tie the game. The hosts made crucial shots down to prevail.
Cobe Williams shined for the hosts, adding 5 assists to his 17-point offensive contribution. Mateo Seric also scored 17, with Ben Burnham and Jannis Von Seckendorff scoring in double digits too. Henri Drell impressed for Neptunas during the comeback attempt, finishing with 21 points and 6 boards.

media:group.media:title: Balkan Botevgrad - Bahcesehir College Istanbul | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Bahcesehir College Istanbul confirmed its status as the team to beat in Group D with a record-setting 60-101 victory over Balkan Botevgrad to remain undefeated through two games. It was Bahcesehir's highest winning margin in its four seasons in the competition, surpassing the club's previous record of a 110-70 win over Dolomiti Energia Trento on October 16, 2024.
Aleksa Avramovic led Bahcesehir with 15 points. Isiaha Mike had 14 while Damien Inglis, Malachi Flynn and Tyler Cavanaugh each added 12 in a team-oriented effort. Darnell Edge and Konstantin Toshkov scored 11 apiece for Balkan.

media:group.media:title: Dolomiti Energia Trento - Slask Wroclaw | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Slask earned its first EuroCup victory of the season on the road, taking down Trento 81-94 behind a dominant paint performance and high-tempo execution. After controlling the pace to build a comfortable first-half lead, Slask weathered Trento's third-quarter comeback before taking back control and pushing the lead back to double digits.
Malik Parsons anchored Slask with 17 points, alongside Devin Robinson who scored 15, with both making a major impact in the second half, while John Egbunu chipped in 11. For Trento, Quincy Olivari put up an impactful 17 points and 7 rebounds, with Isaiah Bigelow adding 16 points to keep the home side in the game.

entry.title: Rostock Seawolves - Riga Zelli | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27

media:group.media:title: Rostock Seawolves - Riga Zelli | Round 2 | BKT EuroCup Basketball 2026-27
media:group.media:description:
Rostock recorded its first-ever EuroCup win by topping Zelli 87-86 in Group A at Stadthalle Rostock in Round 2 on Tuesday. Both teams now have 1-1 records in Group A. Owen Klassen and Artur Konontsuk led the winners with 14 points apiece. Klassen added 12 rebounds. Zach Copeland scored 13, including the game-clinching free throws with 1.2 seconds remaining. Tony Perkins paced Zelli with 35 points and 6 steals for a PIR of 42. Martynas Varnas netted 14 points for Zelli, which led 64-66 at halftime. Tyler Wahl tied the game, 83-83, with over a minute left. Konontsuk and Copeland were perfect from the foul line, making Varnas's buzzer-beating three-pointer not enough to win the game.
